purpose: Premium photographic replacement views for the technology scroll tour

assets.prompt:
Generate a new ultra-realistic luxury product photograph of ONE wired earbud from the reference. This is a premium audio campaign close-up, photographed with a medium-format camera and 120 mm macro lens, not a CAD visualization or a 3D illustration. Use the reference for the exact product identity.

Composition: landscape 3:2, earbud diagonally oriented about 25 degrees clockwise from upright. View from a NEW high three-quarter angle looking down toward the two champagne contacts, with the brushed round front plate partly visible at lower left and the gray ear tip behind the right side. A tight but complete isolated earbud portrait, spanning 80% of the canvas width; a short cable curves toward lower right. Do not copy the camera angle of the supplied photograph.

The object has a dark graphite metal body, a circular radially brushed gunmetal faceplate outlined by a hairline champagne metal ring, a curved matte-black soft wing bearing exactly two oblong flush champagne contact pads, gray silicone ear tip with dark inserts, a recessed black oval window and a fine black braided cable. All are the same physical device as the reference, no new parts.

Art direction: sophisticated, restrained and genuinely photographic. Dense nearly-black anodized metal with smooth satin finish. Very fine microscopic machining follows the curvature of the metal, not orange-peel grain. Knife-edge precision on chamfers. Hairline crisp highlight reflections from narrow studio strip lights. Deep dark reflections give the body mass. A broad dim frontal bounce retains shadow detail. Subdued pale champagne contacts. Matte black rubber absorbs light and looks distinct from metal; gray silicone is solid and soft with only very slight translucency at its rim. Fine textile braid has visible individual threads. The camera resolves tiny construction details, without sharpening halos or exaggerated grain. Product in excellent new condition.

Isolate on genuine transparent background with clean alpha edges, as a carefully retouched high-end photography cutout. The entire device must be opaque apart from subtle silicone translucency. ZERO glow around its silhouette, ZERO gray backdrop or shadow, ZERO hazy gradient. No typography, logo, labels, effects, exploded components, neon, shiny yellow gold, pastel materials, inflated toy shapes, or plastic-looking metal. The product should feel weighty, precise and exceptionally expensive.
